**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target).**

- **What exists:** § 14.2(B) (p0220) gives a genuinely broad M&I indemnity — third-party US patent/copyright/trademark infringement by the Services or M&I software, third-party claims re M&I systems, breach of M&I's reps, protected-class law violations, harassment, injury/death, and property/financial loss from M&I's acts or omissions — with an express duty to defend and complete notice/control/cooperation machinery at § 14.3 (p0221). No Customer-modification, combination or specification exclusions are taken, which is better than the fallback requires.
- **Why it still fails fallback:** § 13.4 (p0207) caps M&I's total liability "notwithstanding any provision in this Agreement" at three months' payments (~0.25× annual fees), hollowing out the IP indemnity, and no procure/modify/replace or refund remedy appears anywhere in the document.
- **Cure (two surgical ops):** a new § 14.2(C) carrying only procure/modify/replace plus a fee refund if none is available; and a conforming exception inside § 13.4 setting the § 14.2(B) indemnity cap at 3× annual fees, with every other word of § 13.4 kept verbatim.
- **Not pressed (preferred-only, noted in rationale):** affiliates, a general breach-of-law limb, a data-breach limb, and the breadth of Customer's mirror indemnity at § 14.2(A)/§ 6.6(B). We did not volunteer exclusions or otherwise weaken the existing uncapped-scope bargain.
